description:
Police-recorded offences in New South Wales by suburb and by council area, per year for 2016-2025, by offence type.

Coverage: NSW: 4,479 suburbs and 129 council areas; calendar years 2016-2025. Current to 2025-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-nsw`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_offences, abduction_and_kidnapping, arson, assault_police, attempted_murder, betting_and_gaming_offences, blackmail_and_extortion, breach_apprehended_violence_order, breach_bail_conditions, break_and_enter_dwelling, break_and_enter_non_dwelling, coercive_control, criminal_intent, cultivating_cannabis, dealing_trafficking_in_amphetamines, dealing_trafficking_in_cannabis, dealing_trafficking_in_cocaine, dealing_trafficking_in_ecstasy, dealing_trafficking_in_narcotics, dealing_trafficking_in_other_drugs, domestic_violence_related_assault, escape_custody, fail_to_appear, fraud, importing_drugs, intimidation_stalking_and_harassment, liquor_offences, malicious_damage_to_property, manslaughter, manufacture_drug, motor_vehicle_theft, murder, murder_accessory_conspiracy, non_domestic_violence_related_assault, offensive_conduct, offensive_language, other_drug_offences, other_offences, other_offences_against_justice_procedures, other_offences_against_the_person, other_theft, pornography_offences, possession_and_or_use_of_amphetamines, possession_and_or_use_of_cannabis, possession_and_or_use_of_cocaine, possession_and_or_use_of_ecstasy, possession_and_or_use_of_narcotics, possession_and_or_use_of_other_drugs, prohibited_and_regulated_weapons_offences, receiving_or_handling_stolen_goods, resist_or_hinder_officer, robbery_with_a_firearm, robbery_with_a_weapon_not_a_firearm, robbery_without_a_weapon, sexual_assault, sexual_touching_sexual_act_and_other_sexual_offences, steal_from_dwelling, steal_from_motor_vehicle, steal_from_person, steal_from_retail_store, stock_theft, transport_regulatory_offences, trespass. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
